dedupe_keys.name: colombia municipal panel of recycling payments to waste picker organisations recovered tonnage and landfill disposal 2010 2024

description: This panel follows every Colombian municipality from 2010 to 2024 to show how much waste was recovered by waste pickers and how much still went to landfill after the country began paying organised pickers through the waste collection tariff. The producers are Daniel D. Otero Meza of the University of Sucre and Fernando Vidal-Barrero of the Universidad de Sevilla, who built it from public records of the Superintendencia de Servicios Públicos Domiciliarios and other agencies for their study of landfill diversion and formalisation. Coverage is 1,104 municipalities and 16,560 municipality-years, 316 of which had joined the payment scheme. Each row gives the recovered tonnage reported for payment, the year of joining, final disposal before and after a documented audit of implausible values, population and the value of recovered material; the package also contains the raw inputs, boundaries, recyclable prices and four notebooks. It is available as a free download from Zenodo, with the compiled data under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence and the code under MIT; third-party records keep their issuers' terms. Caveats: reported tonnage reflects payment claims, and non-reported years are treated as missing. Simulation uses: calibrating models of recycling capacity, informal collection and landfill demand at municipal scale. Related records: the What a Waste database (data-what-a-waste-global-database) gives national waste generation and treatment for comparison.
licence: CC BY 4.0 (compiled data); MIT (code); third-party records under their issuers' terms
name: Colombia municipal panel of recycling payments to waste-picker organisations, recovered tonnage and landfill disposal (2010-2024)
provider: Daniel D. Otero Meza (University of Sucre) and Fernando Vidal-Barrero (Universidad de Sevilla), from Superintendencia de Servicios Públicos Domiciliarios (SSPD) records
schema_summary: panel_2010_2024.csv: one row per municipality-year with recovered tonnage reported for payment, year of joining the tariff-financed payment scheme, final disposal before and after an audit, population, value of recovered material and baseline covariates; raw inputs (SSPD SUI recovery, disposal and recovery-station records, fiscal categories, DANE population and prices, IGAC boundaries, recyclable prices); four notebooks and an audit log

sources.note: Creators Otero Meza (University of Sucre) and Vidal-Barrero (Universidad de Sevilla); published 2026-09-24, updated 2026-09-25; replication.zip (113 MB) and panel_2010_2024.csv (4.7 MB); 1,104 municipalities over 2010-2024 (16,560 municipality-years, 316 adopting the scheme); inputs from SSPD (SUI) recovery, final disposal and recovery stations, DANE projections and prices, IGAC boundaries, ACOPLASTICOS prices; disposal audit sets implausible values (outside 5-1,500 kg per capita-year) to missing; code MIT, compiled data CC BY 4.0

title_en: Colombia municipal panel of recycling payments to waste-picker organisations, recovered tonnage and landfill disposal (2010-2024)
